label: Scissors
depicts: Sideways scissors with two finger loops on the left and two cutting blades crossing toward the right
use_when: Use when the interface wants the scissors laid out horizontally rather than standing upright or tilted.
avoid_when: Do not use for the upright or rotated scissors when the handles should not sit clearly to the left of the blades.

label: Server
depicts: Rectangular server rack with two horizontal bays and two small status dots in the lower bay
use_when: Use when the interface wants a clear stacked rack server with shelf like horizontal divisions.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded server appliance when the machine should not taper or soften around the top corners.

label: Server
depicts: Rounded server body with a tapered top shell and two small status lights near the lower center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a softer standalone server body instead of a flat rectangular rack with shelf dividers.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rack server when the machine should be drawn as two stacked rectangular bays.

label: Settings
depicts: Three horizontal slider bars with one round knob on each bar instead of a gear wheel
use_when: Use when the interface wants settings to read as adjustable controls rather than a gear mechanism.
avoid_when: Do not use for the gear wheel when the settings cue should be toothed and circular instead of linear sliders.

label: Settings
depicts: Circular gear wheel with a center hub and short teeth spaced around the outer rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants the familiar gear symbol rather than slider based tuning controls.
avoid_when: Do not use for the slider settings when the cue should not be a round toothed wheel.
